name: Slime Delight
summary:
Slime Delight is a lightweight add-on mod for Farmer's Delight, that adds a handful of food items made using Slimeball or Magma Cream, and - a large bowl of lava. You can drink this bowl of lava directly.

Most Slimeball food give jump boost effect, and most Magma Cream food give Fire Resistance effect.
